level.verb: pluck droppers, land cores by phase
level.scene: Feeder pillar by a DTR; new lane's 4-core armoured cable into the spare way. Docket 'নতুন আউটগোয়িং: গলি 4 · স্পেয়ার ওয়ে'. Inside: busbars marked R, Y, B, N; three spare fuse units (SFU at ON, labels worn off) each fed by a copper dropper that bends and may cross; N link, earthing terminal; cores with ferrule tags R, Y, B, N; armour earth lead. PPE stand beside the van.
flow: GuideIntro: 'নতুন গলির কেবিল পিলারে জুড়তে হবে — ফেজ সিকোয়েন্স যেন ঠিক থাকে।'
Get ready: PPE stand, SFU handle, cores all touchable; hands in before PPE = deadly. Coworker moment A or B holds the first control.
SFU OFF (drag); landing a core with it ON = deadly. ◆ → reason.
Pluck (changed from a finger trace): tap a dropper — it twangs along its full length and the busbar mark it meets lights for that fuse unit; free.
Land (core): drag each lug onto a terminal (R/Y/B → fuse unit fed from that bar; N → N link; armour → earthing terminal). Wrong = slip, lug springs back.
Tighten: hold the insulated spanner until the nut seats; early release leaves it loose (no message).
After phases: ◆ → reason; after N + armour: ◆ → reason.
SFU ON; lane lights; loose lug shows red-white in a one-beat camera glance = slip, fix and switch again.
Shut and padlock (drag + hold); leaving before = slip. ◆ → reason. Pass panel.
level.dealtVariety: Dropper permutation (6, crossing); spare way position; N link and earth sides; cable entry side; core order; SFU start; coworker moment and side; body; reason libraries.
deadly: Hands into the live pillar without full PPE (incl. myth 1)

N core on a fuse unit or earth terminal

level.gestureHints: Get ready: sweep over PPE, SFU, cores. SFU waiting: sweep over SFU and cores. Pluck state: sweep over all droppers. Land: upward drag on a lug; sweep over all terminals. Tighten: hold ring on the spanner. Switch-on: sweep over SFU and door. Door: drag in its closing direction; padlock hold ring. Leave: sweep over van and door. Decks built-in.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: EARTH CONFLICT ACROSS MODULES: 6.11a and the gate make signing off with a broken earth path deadly (as 4.6b does), but 3.5b scored listening to 'আর্থ তারটা একটু কাটা তো কী' as a slip. Pick one rule for Modules 3, 4 and 6.
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Adopt the single rule (broken earth path = deadly, weak but connected = slip) and re-score 3.5b.
ownerDecisions.basis: National law over WBSEDCL. CEA Safety Regulations 2023 Reg 43(ix)(c): earthing must 'retain electrical continuity' and be tested 'before ... apparatus are energised'. Reg 50(1)(i) requires earthing to limit touch and step voltage. Reg 77(1) says the arrester's job is to send lightning surges to earth because they 'may result into injuries'. DHBVN Safety Manual Don'ts 8: 'DO NOT disconnect earthing connection'. Precedent M1-4 ruling B1: listening is deadly only when the act pushed is deadly in that level, so 3.5b listening becomes deadly once the act is deadly.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: DO-FUSE CONFLICT: lesson 6.3 says WBSEDCL 11 kV DTRs and AB switches 'সাধারণত ড্রপ আউট (DO) ফিউজ ব্যবহার করা হয় না', while M3 3.4 and M4 4.4 play DO fuses on DTRs. Module 6 uses HG only. Decide how the ladder reconciles this.
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Split into two. (2a) Module 6 levels show the WBSEDCL DTR with AB switch + HG fuses only (WBSEDCL HVDS BOQ; CEA 2023 Reg 37(3)(i) allows either). (2b) Built M3/M4 levels keep their DO fuses; add one short line on the 3.4 picture board: some companies use DO fuses, a normal WBSEDCL DTR has AB switch + HG fuses (owner to give the natural Bangla wording). Ask a WBSEDCL lineman whether older DTRs/branch lines still have DO fuses.
ownerDecisions.basis: CEA Safety Regulations 2023 Reg 37(3)(i): 'a linked switch with fuse or gang operated air break switch with fuse or circuit breaker'. WBSEDCL HVDS BOQ, Malda 2020 (items 1.17, 1.18, 1.26: TPGO isolator + 'H.T Horn Gap Fuse Unit', no DO fuse). No WBSEDCL document found that says DO fuses are never used. A WBSEDCL field lineman can say whether older transformers or branch lines in his division still have DO fuses.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: SPEED CONFLICT: 2.5/do/1 slips a rushed hot-stick AB turn, but 6.4 says 'দ্রুত এবং দৃঢ়ভাবে' for the AB's own ground handle. Proposal: only a stalled stroke is a slip in 6.4, and add a note in MODULE2_LADDER.
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Apply ruling A3 in 6.4 and in 2.5/do/1.
ownerDecisions.basis: Owner ruling A3 (2026-11-15, OWNER_DECISIONS_M1-4): 'AB switch: one firm, continuous stroke after the preparation. A slow or stalled stroke = slip.' DHBVN Safety Manual Don'ts 9: 'DO NOT open or close switch or fuse slowly or hesitatingly.' WBSEDCL TPGO isolator spec cl 4.4(iii): a spring makes contact opening speed 'independent of the speed of manual operation'.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Confirm the deadly rows marked needsOwner: closing an AB on load; the rod-hook-before-clamp rule carried from M1; field tank opening and re-charging a burnt-oil DTR (6.1b and gate); landing a core with the SFU ON and water on a live joint (6.9); a bare-hand bypass pull (6.10b); an earth set on a live section (gate, M1 rule); the optional 6.1a climb push.
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Confirm the eight deadly rows. Lower field tank opening on a dead, earthed transformer to slip in do_6_1_b and the gate.
ownerDecisions.basis: TANGEDCO Safety Manual p.65: isolators 'should not be operated (open or close) on charged line / transformer'. WBSEDCL buys these as 'off-load' isolators. OSHA 1910.269(n)(6)(i): 'attach the ground-end connection first'. CEA 2023 Reg 21(1) and DHBVN Don'ts: touch nothing unless 'DEAD AND EARTHED'. DHBVN: 'DO NOT throw water on live electrical equipment'. CEA Schedule I Part-II(6), and precedent M1-4 B8: earth on a live line is deadly everywhere. Precedent M5-1: re-charging a transformer after a blow without finding the cause is deadly; lesson 6.1 says 'চার্জ করার ঝুঁকি নেবেন না'. Tank opening: IS 10028-3 cl 5.4.2 (national standard) treats it as a moisture/fire procedure risk. Precedent M5-6: a lesson's 'মারাত্মক' about equipment harm with nobody exposed stays a slip. Precedent A4: never touch a running transformer tank.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Confirm the slip rows marked needsOwner, in particular: pliers on an HRC (judge changed it from deadly to slip); a swollen capacitor unit left in service (if raised to deadly, raise it in 6.7b and the gate together); armour earthed at one end only (6.5a, unlike 4.6b's strip); hands-on in TEST; the capacitor wait cut short; reclosing before the fault is found; a broken R-Y-B sequence; a wrong-SWG tinned fuse wire.
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Confirm all eight as slips with the limits above, and use the reason-card lines from the reference review (owner to give the natural Bangla).
ownerDecisions.basis: Precedent A5: fuse touched or pulled with supply on = deadly, no PPE after proven isolation = slip. OSHA 1910.335(a)(2)(i)(A): insulated fuse tools when the terminals are energized. GE GEH-2743B: bulged capacitors risk 'explosive case rupture'. IS 1255 cl 13.1 (national): armour 'efficiently earthed at both ends'. IS 13925-1 cl 21: the discharge device is 'not a substitute for short-circuiting', so the rod is the real protection. DHBVN/TANGEDCO: do not renew a fuse until the cause is found. Precedent M5-1 (re-charge after a failed test charge = deadly). Precedent M5-6 (equipment harm only = slip). DHBVN Do's 7 'correct size and quality of fuse wire'. Precedent B2 (3.4a thick copper = deadly). The TEST-position and phase-order rows rest on engineering logic; no reference contradicts them.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Capacitor wait minimum: 5 game minutes (recommended) or 10. This applies to 6.7a and the gate.
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: 5 minutes, with an optional bonus for waiting 10.
ownerDecisions.basis: OSHA 1910.269(w)(1)(i): 'waits at least 5 minutes ... before applying the short circuit'. TANGEDCO Safety Manual (Indian discom) p.62: 'wait for at least 5 minutes'. GE GEH-2743B: 'WAIT 5 MINUTES ... THEN SHORT-CIRCUIT AND GROUND'. The national IS 13925-1 10-minute figure is a design limit for the built-in resistor, not a work rule, and it says the rod is the real safeguard. CEA's ten-minute rule is for HVDC filter banks only. Lesson 6.7 '৫-১০ মিনিট' fits.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Accept the judge's verb changes: 6.1b becomes coil forensics; 6.5b uses pegged straight legs; 6.9b uses a dropper pluck; 6.9a has no shutter; 6.10a drops note-taking; 6.10b is auto-framed and renamed m6_meter_swap_proof. 6.8b remains the module's only finger-trace level.

ownerDecisions.basis: REFERENCE_REVIEW M6-7 (game rule, no safety change); precedent M5-9 (verb changes approved as a set); IS 1255 cl 5.3 bending radius.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Should a lineman build an earth pit (6.11a), or should the level frame him as inspecting a contractor's pit? Also: is one Do level enough for 6.11, given 4.6?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Inspect-and-test framing, with one Do level.
ownerDecisions.basis: CEA Safety Regulations 2023 Reg 43(x): the supplier's earths must be 'tested for resistance on dry day during the dry season at least once in a year'. That is a lineman's check-and-test duty whoever dug the pit. TANGEDCO Safety Manual p.79-80: 'three earth pits in triangular formation at a distance of six meter'. Level 4.6 already teaches building. A WBSEDCL lineman can say who digs pits in his division, but the answer does not change this framing.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Gate items not in any single lesson: the combined feeder layout, 'needless outage = slip', the radio to the control room for breaker and recloser, AB-T as the backfeed source, 'both sides' earthing (Module 1), the game-time ratio, and the rank name and badge from the module plan.
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Option 1. Keep the safety items, use rank সিনিয়র and a 5–7 minute gate, and have the owner name the badge.
ownerDecisions.basis: CEA 2023 Schedule I Part-II(3): permit from the 'Operation In-charge' and isolation 'from all sources of energy'. Reg 47(1)(iii): guard against 'inadvertent paralleling or backfeed'. DHBVN cl 8.16: 'completely isolated on both sides ... discharged and earthed'. CEA Schedule I Part-II(4): local earths 'at the zone of working'. Precedent M1 sound-pole ruling (needless outage = slip). Rank সিনিয়র: GAME_PATH_CHECKLIST Module 6. Gate format precedent: M5-12 (5–7 min).
